verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a REST API covering its core operational flows: order decisioning (/decide, /submit, advise), chargeback reporting, login decisions and decision notifications, all reachable over plain HTTP. Nothing shows that UI functions such as account administration, SSO setup, the Integration Console or onboarding are exposed through the API, and Shopify onboarding relies on the Riskified team doing the heavy lifting. missing for 10: documented API–UI parity statement, API coverage of dashboard/admin/configuration functions (users, SSO, settings, Integration Console), a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Riskified API is a REST-based API that supports direct integration using standard HTTP requests.
SDK usage is optional, and all API endpoints can also be accessed directly using HTTP requests.
Notifies Riskified that a chargeback has been submitted for a specific order.
